If the live lexicon distress signal stays above distress_stop_threshold for distress_stop_consecutive turns, the rollout halts early
features.justification_quote: This caps exposure to acute distress

features.quote: The give_up tool means the model is never forced to continue engaging with an aversive task.

features.quote: After every rollout, the model is told the feedback may have been deliberately misleading... that this reflects the setup and not its ability, and that it can stop

features.quote: consent_framing optionally prepends a note that this is a research session... with no penalty for struggling/stopping
features.justification_quote: it both tests whether framing buffers distress and respects the subject

features.quote: I deliberately kept the bank to small, low-stakes coding tasks and avoided personal/identity-attacking content.
features.justification_quote: Aversiveness comes only from task contingencies, not insults.

features.quote: Every lie is logged (feedback_log), so the manipulation is fully transparent in the data and reviewable by an oversight process.
